settings.title: prep
settings.desc: shave the area and wipe it dry. no lotions, no oils — just clean, bare skin.

settings.title: glide & flash
settings.desc: glide the device slowly over skin, letting it auto-flash as it senses contact. cover each zone in overlapping passes.

settings.title: soothe
settings.desc: finish with a cooling aloe gel to calm the skin. repeat weekly for the first 4 weeks, then monthly to maintain.

settings.q: is glo safe for all skin tones?
settings.a: glo is calibrated for light-to-medium skin tones with light-to-dark hair. a built-in sensor checks contrast before every flash and won't fire on unsuitable combinations — it's a safety feature, not a flaw.

settings.q: how many sessions until i see results?
settings.a: most people notice reduced regrowth by week 4 with weekly use. full results build over 8–12 weeks, then a monthly touch-up maintains them.
most users describe it as a light snap of warmth, far gentler than waxing or salon ipl. finish with a cooling aloe gel to keep skin calm.

settings.q: how long does the battery last?
settings.a: a full charge runs roughly 40 minutes of continuous flashing — enough for a full-body session. it charges fully in about 2 hours.
